rows.name:
Even monsters give up
chasing you eventually...

If you're going to run, make sure to
sheathe your weapon first!

I hear that defeated monsters
sometimes drop money and items!

And don't they also drop HP Potions
when you inflict Down on them?

Did you know some Driver Arts can
have additional effects?

First you Break the enemy!
Then you Topple them!

I see...
And then what?

Once they're Toppled, they're easy
targets. You won't miss a single
attack!

Driver Combos don't work as well
on some enemies... Some are completely
immune, even!
Wow... They must be pretty tough.

Of course, we don't have to worry
about that since we're not Drivers!

If you approach a monster from behind,
it won't even notice you.

Not all of them. I learned that
the hard way when one of them
spotted me and gave chase!

Really? I guess the wise stay away
from danger.

Enemies guard from different
directions. Some only from the front,
others from the front and sides.

I heard some monsters can
power up their allies!
Then we have to take those out first!

Traveling to Aurium is such a pain,
mo. If only we could take a break at
Bern on the way, mo!

Traveling to Aurium is much easier
now, mo! We can rest up at Bern before
the last leg of the journey, mo!

I heard Laura-sama drove the Gogols
away from Bern, mo! I'm grateful, mo~!

It's hard to work when
the lantern's out...

Yeah, I wish someone would
fix it already.

The lantern's fixed!
Now we can get some work done.

Apparently, a guy called Calcedo
arranged it. We owe him one!

Did you hear? It was a Knight of Iira,
Laura-sama herself, who fixed the
lanterns!

Sounds like Laura-sama has been active
all over the place...

Obibi-san at the clothing shop hasn't
seemed well lately, mo~.

Probably because Obibi-san isn't
popular with Nopon and isn't making
any money, mo.
This trendy hat is so cool, mo~!

Obibi-san seems much happier lately,
mo!

I heard Laura, the new Knight of Iira,
was behind this hat, mo.
Wow, what a multitalented person, mo.

That handyman Dio is incredible. He'll
take on any task, free of charge!

Really? Maybe I'll ask him for help
next time I'm in a pinch.

Dio is skilled, but these days it's
Laura-sama, the Knight of Iira, right?

Laura-sama helps lots of people in
need together with Adel-sama.
That's not easy. I'm impressed.

Ivan and the others brought food from
the capital, right?
Apparently Adel-sama prepared it all.
As expected of Adel-sama! So kind...

The capital, Aurium, is peaceful
today, too.
I wouldn't want to leave the capital.

Yes. If only there were a safe place
in the capital...

I hear they built a shelter
beneath the Dormire Inn! We should
be safe now.

And it's all thanks to Laura-sama.
We owe her so much.

You'd best get those materials
delivered, or you'll be in for an
earful from Zain!

Aren't you going to evacuate
with everyone else, old man?

Evacuate? Hah! I'm not budging an inch
from this spot!

I hear young Wotta built a Divine
Beast vessel! Now we can easily
evacuate!

Weren't you just saying you wouldn't
budge an inch?

Laura-sama and Adel-sama helped with
it. Of course I'm going to ride it!
...Right.

Hey, can't we go into this garden and
play?

Oh! Laura-sama!
Thank you for fixing up the gardens!
The view from here is magnificent.

Is it all right for you to be slacking
off here?

I'm not slacking off. I'm here on an
inspection.

It's wonderful to be able to look out
on this view once again.

Indeed. We have the hard work of
Bry and Kaym to thank for it.
What a beautiful garden...

That's because the gardener, Bry-san,
takes care of it.

This used to be such a
beautiful garden...
I can't forgive Heaven's Holy Grail...

It's so good to see Sachsum Gardens
looking beautiful again.

Of course! Laura-sama and Adel-sama
helped us!
Why are you acting so proud about it?

Remember, stay out of the back alleys.
There are some shady Nopon back there.

I know! My mom is always telling
me to stay away.

The Nopon in the back alleys are
awful. They even litter...

My mom said so, too. They're scary...
What if they take notice of me?

Looks like the Nopon from the back
alleys are gone.
Awesome! Let's go play there!

If we do that,
we'll be delinquents too!

Iiran Trout is cheap and tasty, isn't
it?

That's because they farm them. I
prefer the taste of Amber Sweetfish,
though.

I heard all the fish at the farm were
wiped out in the attack...

How awful... Does that mean
the prices will go up?

I heard the fish are back at the farm
thanks to Laura-sama and Adel-sama.

That's a relief! I'm sure Fisshi-san
is, too.

My apologies, but we're all out
of Armu right now.
Oh dear, that's quite a problem...

The Armu are back! Young Joey
managed to sort everything out!

That's good to hear. I need to borrow
one to move my luggage.

Where's Formide Shopping Street again?
I need to buy some accessories...

It's right behind you! Honestly, you
have no sense of direction.

Should we get out of the capital? What
if Heaven's Holy Grail comes back?

Don't worry. I'm sure Adel-sama
will do something about it.

We can ride the Divine Beast ship
Wotta-san built now.

That's good. Though I'm planning to
stay here...
Why!? Come with us!
I want to be more fashionable, mo!

There's no point throwing a tantrum
here, mo. We need to go to Formide
Shopping Street...
This lovely hat makes me so happy, mo!

Obibi-san's shop has been doing well
lately, mo!

Today's the day we settle this, little
brother. Once and for all!
I was hoping you'd say that.
Nii-chans, do your best!

Those brothers are at it again...
Don't they ever get tired of it?

When the city was attacked,
you ran away!
You coward!

Grrr...
You're right...
Onii-chan, you ran away too, right?

Only Adel-sama and the others stood up
to them.

This isn't the time to fight. Let's
join forces, brother.

You're right... Let's join forces
to defeat Heaven's Holy Grail.
Be careful, you two!

We'll be fine! Besides, we're also
acting as lookouts.

Laura-sama! You drove off the Gogols
at the main gate, didn't you?

I was watching from a distance,
and you looked so cool!

I know, right?! I want to be a Driver,
too, someday!

Laura-sama! Please defeat Heaven's
Holy Grail no matter what!

I'll be cheering you on from this
perfect spot!

A Gulan and an Invidian as a pair?
That's rare.
That Torigoriuto sounds nice...
They really are good performers.
They're so cool!

I'm glad these two were around
when Heaven's Holy Grail attacked.

The valiant sound of the Iiran Viella
gave us courage.

Leon-san's Iiran Viella playing has
been especially lively recently.
Seems like something good happened.

The addition of Rikoko's flute has
brought a new flavor to their music.

Yes, the young Nopon brings a certain
joyful energy to the performance!
Laura-samaaa!

Sorry about that, Laura-sama.
Laura-sama is this child's idol, you
see.

Laura-sama! After you defeat
Heaven's Holy Grail, you
have to tell us all about it!

Everyone... This is a selfish request
from an old man, but please safeguard
these children's future.
Look! It's Laura-sama!
And Adel-sama and Yuugo-sama, too!
I'm going to play with them, mo!

Is everything really going to be okay?
Are we going to survive?
O-of course we will!

That's right, mo! They'll take care of
them in a flash, mo!

Step right up! Delicious manjuu for
sale!

Adel-sama!
Please, stop by for a moment!

Laura-sama!
Would you like to have a meal with us?

Shin-sama! You must teach me how to
cook sometime!

Which one should I get?
Choosing accessories is so hard...
How about a Vow Ring?

If only I had better accessories,
I could have driven off
Heaven's Holy Grail's minions.

I don't think that's all it would
take. You'd need strong weapons and
Blades, too.

To protect myself, I need to equip
the best accessories.

Instead of buying them, isn't it
better to defeat enemies and take
theirs?
Are you out of Platinum Meco...?

That's a rare one. The fragrance, the
texture... It's a true delicacy.

If you're in trouble, you're better
off asking Dio or Laura-san than the
Iiran army.

True, but relying on them for
everything is a bit pathetic, isn't
it?

You're right.
We need to contribute, too.

Hey, what do you think will happen to
Iira?

I don't know...
But I have faith in Adel-sama.
I'm sure he'll figure something out.
This inn is lovely, isn't it?

The atmosphere is so different
from back home. It's very relaxing.

Hey, shouldn't we be heading home
soon?

I can't book passage on a Divine Beast
ship. They're always full.

Hmm...
What should we do...?

In the end, we never made it back
home. But that's okay...

I've grown quite fond of this city.
And I'm sure that handsome prince will
sort everything out.
Focus!

At this rate, Heaven's Holy Grail's
Devices will defeat you again!

We will protect Iira's future with our
own hands!
Let's go eat Café Amicus's specialty!
But I'm not hungry yet...
We should probably head home soon.

I don't want to be in a small space!
What if those scary things come back
and I get trapped?

When Adel-sama and the others start
fighting, you need to take shelter in
the inn's basement.

Will it hold...?
I'm scared...

You're always reading.
Let's do something else!

Just let me finish *The Adventures of
the Blue Kevi Seal*.

Come on, cheer up.
I know that was scary, but there's no
point in moping around.

I'm researching the legend of Eden...
Why was this place attacked...?

Let's go to Formide Shopping Street!
I heard the chairman of the Chamber of
Commerce is giving out snacks.

I'll go after I finish my Laura-sama
observation diary...
Is this all the cargo for today?

The damage wasn't too bad around here,
luckily.

We need to be ready to distribute
supplies, just in case.
Medium Gate is still closed.

We'll have to go around through
Formide Shopping Street to get to the
palace.

Why not join the Iiran army?
Let us protect our country together!

Why are you trying to recruit me? In a
peaceful capital like this, there's no
particular need, right?

Why not join the Iiran army? Can you
forgive them for trampling on our
capital?

No thanks. I'm not a Driver. I'd just
die for nothing.
The Iiran army...

I'll lend you my strength. I want to
do something useful for my country,
too.

Things have gotten dangerous lately.
I heard Gogols almost made it to the
city gates.

I know. Laura-sama drove them off,
right? She's amazing.

I heard that Thales-san, the
glassmaker, passed away.

He didn't have a successor, did he? I
suppose his skills will be lost
forever.
Have you seen Sharla-san's glasswork?

Yeah. Not at Thales-san's level yet,
but there's a lot of potential.

Hey, hey, have you seen Sarah's
boyfriend?

I have!
He's so handsome.
Are you serious?

I haven't seen Mirei's grandmother
around lately, have you?

Looks like she got back together with
her ex-husband. She will make pottery
in Haiber Village.

That Tricolor Mottled Roll I had for
the first time in ages was really
delicious.

It's all thanks to that eager
Superbian and Adel-sama.

I hear the cooking contest Adel-sama
proposed was a huge success, mo.

Next time, I'll ask the Chamber
chairman to make Formide Shopping
Street livelier and earn more, mo.

There's someone named Jericho down
there. Go and ask him.

I wonder if it's okay... He's not as
scary as he used to be, but...

Parvi and Dodon looked happy.
I wonder if they found that gold?

Those two are always like that.
I bet they failed again, didn't they?

Parvi seems to have a lot of money
these days, huh?

Parvi found legendary gold in the
Dana Desert, they say. I thought it
was hopeless, but dreams do come true.
That's Aureus Palace.

It's so tall!
How many floors does it have?

Hey, boss... Was the Chamber of
Commerce Chairman a bad guy?

No, he just tried too hard. From now
on, I'm sure he'll work for the
shopping street without overdoing it.

I heard a Divine Beast-sama bought a
huge amount of meat and fish at the
shopping street the other day...

I suppose when you're that big,
you need to eat a lot.

Things have been hard lately, but I'm
glad it all worked out for Mars-san.

Yes. Kai-kun and Kei-chan cheered us
up, too.

We're so useless, aren't we? When this
place was attacked by monsters, we
couldn't do a thing...

We'll just have to become skilled
Drivers like Adel-sama and Yuugo-sama!

It's good to be in Aletta,
but we're short on manpower.

Still, Adel-sama's retainers are
helping us out, so there's no point in
complaining.

Thanks to the lieutenant and
Adel-sama, our manpower shortage may
be over. Six new people at once!

Though those four Nopon combined are
worth about one person...

We need to learn from Laura-sama's
fighting style. The way the Driver and
Blade pass weapons back and forth...

This is Adel-sama's domain,
so it's safer here than in Invidia.

Yeah...
We can finally get some rest, Mama.

I want you to grow up to be strong,
like Laura-sama, Kasumi-sama, and
Kagutsuchi-sama.
But not like Hikari-sama?

Adel-sama, everyone...
Good luck...
Please bring peace to Alst.

Shouldn't we be accompanying
Yuugo-sama?

This is Iira. The Superbian army can't
move around freely. Let's follow
orders and stick to relaying messages.

Where has the Special
Commissioner-dono gone?

He went with Yuugo-sama, didn't he?
That man is like a walking disaster.
I'd feel safer if he returned home.

Rumors of Yuugo-sama's exploits
have reached us even here...

It makes me proud. But I wish he would
allow us to accompany him!

Were the weapon and accessory
merchants evacuated?

Yes, they've taken shelter in the
inn's basement.

The bridge has finally been
restored...

We shouldn't rest here.
Let's hurry to the capital.

I'm glad we left the capital early.
To think it would be attacked...

I know...
Let's hurry back to Aletta.

Should we...should we escape from
Iira? From Aletta? Is it that bad?

It's hard to say... But I have faith
in Adel-sama. I know it will be okay.
